footer_tagline: Print on demand for independent designers.
home_hero_body: Original artwork from independent designers, printed and shipped by independent print shops. No inventory, no upfront costs — just pick a design and we'll handle the rest.
home_hero_tagline: Independent designers · Independent fulfillment · One platform
home_step_01_body: Scroll hundreds of original designs across dozens of categories. Filter by style, color, or product.
home_step_02_body: Choose a design, pick your product — tee, hoodie, mug, poster — and we'll mock it up for you in seconds.
home_step_03_body: An independent print shop near you produces the order and ships it directly. No warehouse, no markup.
home_why_01_body: Every design is uploaded by a real artist who sets their own price.
home_why_02_body: Local fulfillment, not a single mega-warehouse halfway across the world.
home_why_03_body: Nothing is made until you order it. Zero waste, zero deadstock.
home_why_04_body: Designers keep control of their work and earn on every sale.
legal_privacy_section_2_body: To operate the Service: fulfill orders, process payments, send transactional notifications (order placed / shipped / delivered), prevent fraud, and improve the platform.
legal_privacy_section_3_body: We share data only with the parties needed to fulfill your order (the printer assigned to each order item; the delivery company; the payment provider). We do not sell personal data.
legal_privacy_section_4_body: We use a session cookie for web authentication and an optional Sanctum bearer token (stored in an HttpOnly cookie) for API access. No third-party advertising cookies.
legal_privacy_section_5_body: Account data is retained while the account is active. Soft-deleted records are purged after 90 days. Order records are retained for 7 years for tax compliance.
legal_privacy_section_6_body: You can export your account data (settings → account export) and request deletion at any time, subject to retention requirements.
legal_terms_section_1_body: By creating an account on POD Platform ("the Service") you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
legal_terms_section_2_body: The Service supports four roles: customer (browses and orders), designer (publishes designs), printer_provider (fulfills orders), and admin (operates the platform). Each role has specific permissions defined in PermissionMatrix-v1.2.
legal_terms_section_3_body: Orders are placed via the checkout flow at /checkout. Prices are snapshotted on order_items.unit_price at placement time. The platform does not charge tax in v1.2.
legal_terms_section_4_body: Designers retain copyright on designs they upload. By publishing a design you grant the platform a non-exclusive license to reproduce the design on the chosen product templates for the purpose of fulfilling orders.
legal_terms_section_5_body: Printers are independent contractors. Delivery times are estimates, not guarantees. Risk of loss passes to the customer upon carrier acceptance.
legal_terms_section_6_body: Orders may be cancelled before the status transitions to shipped. After shipment, refunds are handled case-by-case.
legal_terms_section_7_body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or the permissions matrix.
